install: How to add it to your phone?
step1: Open your browser menu (the three dots at the top right)
step3: Choose a name, and it will appear on your phone like a normal app

hero.title: My goal is to help you get closer to Allah from anywhere, at any time
hero.description: Whether you want to read, listen, or remember Allah, this website is designed to make your journey with the Quran and your daily ibadah easier and more consistent.

features.heading: What you’ll use every day
features.subheading: Everything you need to stay close to the Quran and your عبادات, all in one place.

readQuran.title: Read Quran
readQuran.desc: Easily read the Quran with access to tafsir and accurate recitation of the verses.

listenQuran.title: Listen to Quran
listenQuran.desc: Choose your favorite reciter and listen with ease wherever you are.

listenRadio.title: Listen to Radio
listenRadio.desc: Listen to a variety of radio programs through live streaming.

searchAyah.title: Find an Ayah
searchAyah.desc: Search by words or sentences and reach the verses you’re looking for in seconds.

azkar.title: Azkar & Duaa
azkar.desc: All the daily Azkar you need in one place.

hadith.title: Read Hadith
hadith.desc: Browse authentic hadith in a simple and focused way.

tools.heading: Small tools that make a big difference
tools.subheading: To help you stay consistent, even on busy days.

prayerTimes.title: Prayer Times
prayerTimes.desc: Stay aware of your prayers with accurate timings based on your location.

tasbeeh.title: Tasbeeh Counter
tasbeeh.desc: Say azkar in a simple and quick way

sadaqaGarya.title: Ongoing Charity
sadaqaGarya.desc: Create an ongoing charity for a person you care about and share it with others.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.desc: Save what touches your heart for easy return anytime.

sadaqat.title: My Sadaqat
sadaqat.desc: Keep a personal record of your charity and intentions.

ayahToImage.title: Ayah to Image
ayahToImage.desc: Turn any Ayah into a beautiful image.

installFlow.heading: Keep it one tap away
installFlow.subheading: Install it once, and it will always be there when you need a moment with Allah.
installFlow.step3: Confirm and access it anytime with one tap.

cta.heading: Take a small step today
cta.description: Start with a few verses, a short listen, or simple Zekr.
